theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 58 群

items.pos: n. 管道；頻道 | v. 傳送
items.colloc: communication channel 溝通管道 | distribution channel 配銷通路
items.distinct: conduit 導管（物理）| medium 媒介（抽象）
ex: Feedback is sent through the official channel.
意見回饋透過正式管道傳送。
The company is channeling resources into R&D.
公司正將資源投入研發部門。
We need to open a new sales channel.
我們需要開拓一個新的銷售通路。

items.colloc: complicate matters 把事情搞複雜 | unnecessarily complicate 不必要地複雜化
items.distinct: complex 複雜的（形容詞）| perplex 使困惑
ex: These new regulations only complicate the process.
這些新規定只會讓流程變複雜。
Do not complicate the issue any further.
不要再把問題搞複雜了。
The unexpected delay complicated our project timeline.
意料之外的延遲讓專案時程變複雜了。

items.pos: prep. 關於 | adj. 令人擔憂的
items.colloc: concerning the matter 關於此事 | concerning news 令人擔憂的消息
items.distinct: regarding 關於（更正式）| regarding 關於
ex: I have a question concerning the new contract.
我有個關於新合約的問題。
The recent decline in sales is concerning.
近期銷售額的下滑令人擔憂。
We received an email concerning the audit.
我們收到了一封關於審計的郵件。

items.colloc: confused about 對…感到困惑 | confused by 被…弄糊塗
items.distinct: bewildered 目瞪口呆的 | muddled 腦筋糊塗的
ex: He was confused by the complex instructions.
他對那些複雜的說明感到困惑。
Staff members were confused about the meeting time.
員工們對會議時間感到困惑。
I am confused by the changes in policy.
我對政策的變更感到困惑。

items.colloc: take into consideration 列入考慮 | under consideration 在審議中
items.distinct: contemplation 沉思 | reflection 省思
ex: Your proposal is currently under consideration.
您的提案目前正在審議中。
Thank you for your consideration regarding this matter.
感謝您對此事的體貼考量。
Please take his past experience into consideration.
請將他過去的經驗納入考量。

items.colloc: definite answer 明確的答覆 | definite plan 明確的計畫
items.distinct: definitive 決定性的 | explicit 詳盡明確的
ex: We need a definite answer by tomorrow.
我們明天前需要一個明確的答覆。
There is no definite date for the launch.
發布日期目前還沒有明確下來。
Her commitment to the project is definite.
她對這項專案的投入是確定的。

items.colloc: deliberately ignore 故意忽略 | act deliberately 行事謹慎
items.distinct: intentionally 蓄意地 | on purpose 故意地
ex: He did not do it deliberately.
他並不是故意要那樣做的。
The report was deliberately kept confidential.
這份報告被刻意地保密。
She spoke slowly and deliberately during the talk.
她在演講時說話既緩慢又謹慎。

items.pos: n. 高興；樂事 | v. 使高興
items.colloc: to one's delight 令某人高興的是 | take delight in 以…為樂
items.distinct: pleasure 愉快 | joy 喜悅
ex: It is a delight to work with you.
能與您共事是我的榮幸。
The new features delighted our long-term clients.
新功能讓長期客戶感到滿意。
To our delight, the project succeeded early.
令我們高興的是，專案提早成功了。

items.colloc: at a disadvantage 處於劣勢 | major disadvantage 主要缺點
items.distinct: drawback 缺點 | demerit 短處
ex: High costs put us at a disadvantage.
高昂成本使我們處於劣勢。
What is the main disadvantage of this plan?
這項計畫的主要缺點是什麼？
The lack of experience is a slight disadvantage.
缺乏經驗是一個小小的劣勢。

items.pos: adj. 有活力的；推動的 | n. 駕駛
items.colloc: driving force 推動力 | driving ambition 強烈的野心
items.distinct: propulsive 推進的 | dynamic 動態的
ex: Innovation is the driving force behind our growth.
創新是我們成長背後的推動力。
He has a driving ambition to succeed.
他有成功的強烈企圖心。
The driving rain delayed the supply delivery.
大雨延誤了物資的運送。

items.pos: v. 選舉；選擇 | adj. 當選的
items.colloc: elect a representative 選出代表 | elect to do something 選擇做某事
items.distinct: select 挑選 | choose 選擇
ex: The board will elect a new chairman today.
董事會今天將選出新任主席。
They elected to extend the contract period.
他們選擇延長合約期限。
Members will elect the new management team.
成員們將選出新的管理團隊。

items.colloc: consumer electronics 消費性電子產品 | electronics industry 電子產業
items.distinct: electric 電力的 | electrical 電氣的
ex: Our company dominates the local electronics market.
我們公司主導了當地的電子市場。
He works for a leading electronics firm.
他在一家領先的電子公司工作。
The electronics store is having a sale.
那家電子產品商店正在促銷。

items.colloc: look elsewhere 到別處尋找 | seek elsewhere 在其他地方尋求
items.distinct: somewhere 某處 | nowhere 無處
ex: If you are not satisfied, look elsewhere.
如果您不滿意，可以到別處看看。
We might have to source components elsewhere.
我們可能必須去別處採購零件。
The talent we need is available elsewhere.
我們需要的人才在別處找得到。

items.colloc: well established 根基穩固的 | established company 老字號公司
items.distinct: founded 成立的 | traditional 傳統的
ex: We are an established leader in the field.
我們是該領域中已確立的領導者。
The established procedures must be followed strictly.
必須嚴格遵守既定的程序。
This is an established firm with long history.
這是一家歷史悠久且穩固的公司。

items.colloc: exaggerate the results 誇大結果 | do not exaggerate 不要誇大
items.distinct: overstate 誇大陳述 | overemphasize 過度強調
ex: Do not exaggerate the potential benefits of this.
不要誇大這件事的潛在利益。
He tends to exaggerate his past achievements.
他傾向於誇大過去的成就。
The report did not exaggerate the risks involved.
報告並沒有誇大所涉及的風險。

items.colloc: exposed to risk 暴露於風險 | exposed to sunlight 暴露在陽光下
items.distinct: vulnerable 易受傷的 | unprotected 未受保護的
ex: The company is exposed to market volatility.
該公司暴露在市場波動的風險中。
These areas are exposed to extreme weather.
這些區域暴露在極端天氣下。
Data can be exposed if not encrypted properly.
如果未正確加密，資料可能會外洩。

items.colloc: extraordinary effort 非凡的努力 | extraordinary success 非凡的成功
items.distinct: exceptional 特殊的 | remarkable 卓越的
ex: She made an extraordinary contribution to the team.
她為團隊做出了非凡的貢獻。
The growth this year has been extraordinary.
今年的成長非常驚人。
He showed extraordinary skill during the crisis.
他在危機期間展現了非凡的技巧。

items.colloc: failure to comply 未能遵守 | system failure 系統故障
items.distinct: flop 徹底失敗 | breakdown 損壞
ex: Failure to finish on time will cost us.
未能準時完成將使我們付出代價。
The project was a failure due to poor planning.
由於計畫不周，該專案失敗了。
Technical failure caused the website to crash.
技術故障導致網站崩潰。

items.pos: adj. 根本的；基礎的 | n. 基本原理
items.zh: 根本的；基礎的；基本原理
items.colloc: fundamental change 根本性的改變 | fundamental principles 基本原則
items.distinct: essential 必要的 | basic 基本的
ex: These are the fundamental rules of our business.
這些是我們業務的基本原則。
We need to make a fundamental shift in strategy.
我們需要對策略進行根本性的轉變。
Understanding customers is fundamental to our success.
了解客戶是我們成功的根本。

items.pos: adj. 更進一步的 | v. 促進 | adv. 進一步地
items.zh: 更進一步的；促進；進一步地
items.colloc: further information 進一步資訊 | further development 進一步發展
items.distinct: farther 更遠的（空間）| additional 額外的
ex: Please contact us for further information.
請聯繫我們以獲取進一步資訊。
We need to discuss this further tomorrow.
我們明天需要再進一步討論此事。
The program helps to further your career prospects.
該計畫有助於促進您的職涯前景。
